title: AutoArena launch ledger row
description: One line of runs/<run>/launches.jsonl, written by the engine. Append-only, single writer, flush after each append. Three row types: intent (before the launch), result (after it exits), adjudication (a correction, which supersedes an earlier row for the same launch_uuid without deleting it). Methods submit candidates through the experiment API; the engine records their research logs and measured results here.

launch_seq.description: attempt ordinal, never reused, so a refunded attempt keeps a stable identity

compute_handle.description: backend-scoped id for this launch, e.g. a queue task id

compute_run_id.description: the platform's own record of the worker incarnation; the set of distinct values is the restart witness

idea.description: Optional. Free-form for a method that has cards; the harness records it and never interprets it.

research_log.description: Method-authored account recorded before execution. Required for every candidate; engine reference initialization is exempt. Ideas must be nonempty. Status is optional and must be nonblank when supplied. The engine does not judge the content.

witness.description: the substrate's gpu_work_witness string was present in this launch's own stdout; decides charging, and is tested before exit_code

metrics.description: Every metric declared by the task, at declared precision. null where the launch produced no value.

ground.description: why, stated so a reader who was not there can check it

abandoned.description: true settles a launch whose result cannot arrive; the decision still determines charging
